कठ् {c1c} P. (कठति, अकठीत्, कठित)
To live in distress; see कंठ्.

1 N. of a sage, pupil of
Vaiśampāyana, teacher of that branch
of Yajurveda which is called after
him.
--2 A Brāhmaṇa.
--3 A note or
[]
simple sound.
--4 A kind of ṛk.
--ठाः The followers of that sage.
--ठी
1 A female follower of Kaṭha.
--2 The
wife of a Brāhmaṇa.
--Comp.
--अध्यापकः a teacher of the Kaṭha branch
of the Yajurveda.
--धूर्तः a Brāhmaṇa
well-versed in the कठ branch of the
Yajurveda.
--श्रोत्रियः a Brāhmaṇa
who has mastered the कठ branch of
the Yajurveda.

कठिंजरः N. of a tree commonly
called तुलसी.

; so ˚स्तनौ.
--2
Hardhearted, cruel, ruthless; न विदीर्ये
कठिनाः खलु स्त्रियः

; so ˚हृदय.
--3 Inexorable’
inflexible.
--4 Sharp, violent, intense
(as pain &c.); नितांतकठिनां रुजं मम न
वेद सा मानसीं

.
--5 Giving pain.
--नः A thicket.
--ना
1 A sweetmeat
made with refined sugar.
--2 An
earthen vessel for cooking; (n. also
in this sense).
--नी Chalk.
--Comp.
--पृष्ठः,-कः a tortoise.

कठिनता, --त्वं
1 Hardness, firmness.
--2 Severity.
--3 Cruelty,
hard-heartedness;

कठिनता, --त्वं
1 Hardness, firmness.
--2 Severity.
--3 Cruelty,
hard-heartedness;

कठेर a. Living in distress.
--रः
A needy or distressed man, a
pauper.

कठोर a.
1 Hard(fig. also),
solid, stiff; कठोरास्थिग्रांथि

; so ˚हृदय, ˚चित्त.
--3 Sharp,
piercing; ˚अंकुश Śānti. 1. 22.
--4
Full, developed, complete,
fullgrown, of mature age; कठोरगर्भां
जानकीं विमुच्य

; so कठोरताराधिपलांछनच्छविः
Śi. 1. 20; so अ˚ new, young;

it
is noon-time.
--Comp.
--गर्भ a.
far advanced in pregnancy;

.
--गिरिमाहात्म्यं a portion of
the Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa.

काठिनं, --न्यं
1 Hardness,
tightness; काठिन्यमुक्तस्तनं Ś. 3. 10.
--2
Sternness, hard-heartedness, cruelty.
--3 Difficulty, obscurity (of style).
